title: OpenRTB 2.6 Video
description: Represents a video impression. Video in OpenRTB generally assumes compliance with the VAST standard.

minduration.description: Minimum video ad duration in seconds. Mutually exclusive with rqddurs.

maxduration.description: Maximum video ad duration in seconds. Mutually exclusive with rqddurs.

startdelay.description: Indicates the start delay in seconds for pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll ad placements. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Start Delay Modes.

maxseq.description: Indicates the maximum number of ads that may be served into a dynamic video ad pod.

poddur.description: Indicates the total amount of time in seconds that advertisers may fill for a dynamic video ad pod.

protocols.description: Array of supported video protocols. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Subtypes - Audio/Video.

w.description: Width of the video player in device-independent pixels (DIPS).

h.description: Height of the video player in device-independent pixels (DIPS).

podid.description: Unique identifier indicating that an impression opportunity belongs to a video ad pod.

podseq.description: The sequence (position) of the video ad pod within a content stream.

rqddurs.description: Precise acceptable durations for video creatives in seconds. Mutually exclusive with minduration/maxduration.

plcmt.description: Video placement type for the impression. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Plcmt Subtypes - Video.

linearity.description: Indicates if the impression must be linear, nonlinear, etc. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Linearity Modes.

skip.description: Indicates if the player will allow the video to be skipped, where 0 = no, 1 = yes.

skipmin.description: Videos of total duration greater than this number of seconds can be skippable.

skipafter.description: Number of seconds a video must play before skipping is enabled.

slotinpod.description: Indicates that the seller can guarantee delivery against the indicated slot position in the pod.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second. Price floor for the dynamic portion of a video ad pod.

battr.description: Blocked creative attributes. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Creative Attributes.

maxextended.description: Maximum extended ad duration if extension is allowed. 0 = not allowed, -1 = unlimited.

boxingallowed.description: Indicates if letter-boxing of 4:3 content into a 16:9 window is allowed.

playbackmethod.description: Playback methods that may be in use. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Playback Methods.

playbackend.description: The event that causes playback to end. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Playback Cessation Modes.

delivery.description: Supported delivery methods. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Delivery Methods.

pos.description: Ad position on screen. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Placement Positions.

companionad.description: Array of Banner objects if companion ads are available.

api.description: List of supported API frameworks for this impression. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: API Frameworks.

companiontype.description: Supported VAST companion ad types. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Companion Types.

poddedupe.description: Indicates pod deduplication settings. Refer to AdCOM 1.0 List: Pod Deduplication Settings.

durfloors.description: Array of DurFloors objects indicating floor prices for video creatives of various durations.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.

placement.description: DEPRECATED. Use plcmt instead. Video placement type.

sequence.description: DEPRECATED. Use slotinpod instead. Position in ad pod sequence.
